subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are excited to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123 Date: 15th December 2021 Departure: 10:00 AM We recommend arriving at the airport at least 2 hours before your flight. Please ensure you have all necessary travel documents and adhere to the airline's guidelines. Wishing you a pleasant journey! Regards, The Travel Agency Team
